Case: Patient D is a 57-year-old Hispanic man with history of prior C3-C6 posterior cervical fusion presenting with 4 months of new neck, hand and arm pain. Patient D was doing well for several years after his last surgery, but he now reports severe pain in his from his 3rd-5th digits and the medial aspect of his arms.
